course_name_en: Dance in Istanbul from the 16th Century to the Present

learning_outcomes.text: Discuss the 'Whatness' of dance in linguistic, performative, and political contexts.
Present the understanding of dance within a historical context.
Analyze the inherent meanings of ritualistic bodily acts.
Recognize dance forms in Ottoman performing arts and define them in the context of gender and identity.
Define ballet, modern, and contemporary dance practices in Turkey within the concepts of Westernization.

syllabus_topics: Discussion of dance in Islamic Philosophy in the context of Body, Pleasure, and Sexuality
Plurality of Religious Rituals and Bodily Acts in Turkish-Islamic Culture
Relationship of Dance with Gender and Space in the Ottoman Classical Age
Place of Dance in Daily Life, Celebrations, and Festivals in the Ottoman Empire
Dance Forms and Dancer Identities in Ottoman Performance Dances
National Social Dances in Early Republican Turkey
Midterm 2 / Transformation of Gender Discrimination in Dance: Balls and Weddings
